verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's annual report page says it files annual reports automatically in all states as they come due, through direct integration with secretary of state portals. That makes annual report filing a managed service the provider performs for the founder. The same page also gives visibility into due dates, filing status and approved documents, and the llms.txt probe lists the annual-report service. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actual filings, details on how reports are prepared and what data is collected, and pricing or packaging of the service as an add-on.
